title: Lowest common multiple (LCM)
goal: I can find the lowest common multiple of two or three numbers.
teach: The LCM is the smallest number that is a multiple of each number. List multiples of the bigger number until the other number divides one exactly. Or use prime factors: take every prime the most times it appears in any one number.
watch: 12 × 18 = 216 is a common multiple, but it is not the lowest.

qs.steps:
1. Rule: the LCM (lowest common multiple) is the smallest number in the times tables of all the numbers. List multiples of the biggest number until the others divide into it.
2. Multiples of 9: 9, 18 …
3. 18 ÷ 6 = 3
4. LCM = 18
